u_value.required: FOUR STATEMENTS ACROSS THREE DOCUMENTS. (1) Window schedule 2376-09: 1.4 W/m2K against each window type, 33 notes - PER ELEMENT. (2) Door schedule 2376-08, per-door notes on D.01, D.17, D.22, D.26: 'Door to achieve min u-value of 1.4W/m2k'. (3) Door schedule 2376-08 general note: 'External Doors U-value 1.2 w/m2k. Note this is an AREA WEIGHTED AVERAGE u-value - not a centre pane value.' (4) EDG02 Energy and Carbon Design Guidelines - Building Fabric, refurbishment column: 1.3 W/m2K windows, 1.2 W/m2K external doors, g-value 0.4-0.3. Fenster's proposal promises 1.4 W/m2K throughout.
u_value.basis: windows: per element (2376-09 states it against each type). external doors: whole installation - 2376-08 expressly calls the 1.2 an area weighted average, not a per-element limit
u_value.note: SM5 WEXHAM RULE APPLIED, AND THE FINDING SURVIVES IT. No element is rejected against the average. Instead the average was computed: SMA publish 1.8 W/m2K for Smart Wall doors. Our external door area is 22.078 m2 of Smart Wall Pocket plus at most 20.367 m2 of MC600 (42.445 m2). For the area-weighted average to reach 1.2 with Smart Wall at 1.8, the MC600 area would have to achieve (1.2 x 42.445 - 1.8 x 22.078) / 20.367 = 0.55 W/m2K, which no glazed element achieves. Even a generous MC600 at 1.0 gives a weighted average of 1.42, and at 1.4 gives 1.61 - both miss 1.2. So the doors miss on the architect's OWN averaging basis, not merely on a per-element reading. Separately the four per-door 1.4 notes on D.01/D.17/D.22/D.26 are stated per element and 1.8 misses those outright. NOTE: the only U-value CALCULATION in the job folder is Aplus K_QP70172 of 22/07 - average Uw 1.37 over 210.2 m2 - and it is for TECHNAL frames we did not buy.
